entries.title: Show HN: HackerNew for Chrome
entries.author: tommoor
entries.excerpt: I've been working on and off on a Chrome Extension for Hacker News, the extension focusses on improved usability rather than design. I can almost guarantee that after a day you won't want to go back to regular Hacker News. Give it a try, features include: - Improved readability - Quick inline replies from comments page - Quick profiles with social network info when hovering over usernames - Filtering of stories based on terms and phrases / domain or user - Endless scrolling -
entries.guide_zh: HackerNew 为 Chrome 提供 HN 扩展，侧重改善社区浏览的可用性。
